text:
emma-oncall: paging: p99/streaming tail spikes, lots of SLO alerts showing up. getting paged by ops-bot.
ops-bot: INCIDENT: latency_slo_breach service=redwood-inference env=prod severity=page p95=1.2s p99=4.8s streaming_tail=30s alerts=12
samir-sre: on it. can someone grab p95/p99 histograms + recent deploys since midnight?
lia-ml: I see a spike in prompt preprocessing time on the tokenizer service — a new prompt template change went live ~01:12 UTC, lots of JSON-mode tool schemas pinging. median preprocess went from 20ms -> 400ms for some routes.
kevin-platform: rollback window? deploy-bot shows a canary roll from 01:10 that touched prompt-renderer v2.3.4
morgan-cs: CS: multiple customers reporting slow completions, one enterprise (AcmeCorp) seeing degraded streaming for their live agents. keeping them updated.
emma-oncall: Samir, lia — please triage. I'm handing over oncall to samir at 01:30 UTC. adding incident channel and doing a quick customer impact note.
ops-bot: oncall_handoff: from=emma-oncall to=samir-sre at=1795002600
samir-sre: thanks. first pass: let's confirm correlation across pods/nodes. lia, can you dump tokenizer latency per-worker and include whether it's parsing (template render) vs tokenization CPU?
lia-ml: uploading a short tail sample:
```
route: /v1/chat/stream
template_render_ms: [12, 18, 410, 520, 980]
kv_cache_hit: mostly false
mode: json
tool_schema_parses: increased 6x
```
lia-ml: looks like heavy template expansion + JSON schema validation causing blocking I/O in preproc. hitting a sync validation library we recently updated.
samir-sre: that fits. p95 jump aligns with template render times. streaming stalls likely waiting for preproc to return first tokens. mitigation options: 1) rollback the renderer package 2) feature-flag to disable schema validation 3) route heavy-json customers to dedicated pool.
kevin-platform: quick actionable: we can flip the FF skip_prompt_validation for the service. it'll avoid validation and should shave off ~300-700ms per request. rolling that now to 10% then 100% if green.
samir-sre: do it. post the flag change command and monitor.
kevin-platform: executing:
```
curl -X POST "https://ff.redwood.internal/api/v1/toggles/skip_prompt_validation/rollout" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"env":"prod","percent":10}'
```
deploy-bot: FF_CHANGE: skip_prompt_validation set to 10% for prod by kevin-platform
lia-ml: after 10% flip, template_render_ms for those sampled decreased to [18, 22, 60, 80] on routed pods. p95 trending down for those pods.
samir-sre: good. increase to 50% and then 100% if no fallout. also add a short-term request-level timeout on preproc (3s) to avoid streaming stalls cascading.
kevin-platform: bumping to 50% -> 100%
deploy-bot: FF_CHANGE: skip_prompt_validation set to 100% for prod by kevin-platform
ops-bot: METRIC_UPDATE: p95=320ms p99=980ms streaming_tail=6s (after FF)
morgan-cs: AcmeCorp reporting improvement. they saw streaming resumes within ~10s of our mitigations. filing customer note.
emma-oncall: good run. Samir: please coordinate a rollback of the validation library in dev and a safe deploy plan. lia: capture failing templates and add to evals.
samir-sre: I'll open a rollback PR and a hotfix that offloads validation to async path for streaming. also adding a circuit breaker for template validation CPU.
lia-ml: quick data: about 2.3% of routes were using the new template features that trigger heavy schema validation; they accounted for ~60% of the tail latency in the window.
kevin-platform: actioned short-term configs: increased preproc worker threads on heavy nodes and added request-level timeouts. will keep FF off for now.
morgan-cs: summarizing customer impact: 12 enterprise accounts experienced >5s delays; 3 reported user-visible errors (disconnects). CS will send targeted notes and offer logs export.
samir-sre: post-incident checklist: 1) rollback validation lib in canary + measure 2) implement async schema validation for streaming 3) add perf test for large tool schemas in CI 4) add alert for template_render_ms > 250ms (route-level)
emma-oncall: please include owner + ETA for each action item. I'll draft an initial incident summary for leadership.
lia-ml: owner proposals: async validation = lia-ml (3d), rollback PR = kevin-platform (1d), perf tests = quality (2d), alert = samir-sre (today).
samir-sre: adding to runbook: if template_render_ms spike -> flip skip_prompt_validation FF and contact CS. updating runbook now.
kevin-platform: note — avoid blanket disabling of validation in non-streaming routes; add route-level FF control.
morgan-cs: will prepare customer impact spreadsheet and list of affected orgs + timelines, sending to emma/leadership.
emma-oncall: closing page in 45m. keep this thread updated with PR links and postmortem draft.
samir-sre: will keep thread updated. starting rollback PR now: https://git.redwood/repo/prompt-renderer/pull/458
lia-ml: pushing failing-template examples to S3: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1795002468/templates.jsonl
ops-bot: INCIDENT_RESOLVE: severity downgraded to ticket. final metrics: p95=180ms p99=420ms streaming_tail=2s
morgan-cs: note for postmortem: surface impact to pricing metric customers might have seen higher token costs due to retries.
emma-oncall: great work team. postmortem owners: samir (lead), lia (perf analysis), kevin (deploy/rollback). I'll schedule blameless postmortem tomorrow 15:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
